chunks: Those before them had also denied. And how was My punishment then!
ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Nakir' refer to in Surah Al-Mulk?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Mulk, this verse highlights the cumulative pattern of divine retribution against those who rejected the truth, emphasizing the concept of 'Nakir' (the severe, unexpected punishment) as a direct consequence of arrogance. Shia exegetes often link this to the historical precedents of the Prophets' communities, serving as a timeless warning for the contemporary believer to internalize the message rather than merely acknowledging it intellectually.
